svg.title: The series in four steps and the number each one found. 1, measure: record every request; one request was 98 percent of the bill. 2, pick the model: rules plus a quality check; a perfect router saved only 2.5 percent. 3, send less work: shorter history and answers, reused answers and prompt caching; output was cut 95 percent. 4, prove and guard: check quality before cost; the bot became 88 percent cheaper with facts still 14 of 14.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
